text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
All the letters I've gotten from everyone
have already completely filled up my treasure chest.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "I have to go find another case that could substitute—... Oh, this one."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
W-Wow, how nostalgic.
This is the letter of encouragement from the hospital director.
And this one's from the nurse...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that one over there is
the girl who was in the same hospital room as me.
And then, this one is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: K.S.Miracle ended up rereading all the fan letters she had received up until now, accidentally staying up late into the night.
